intro.h2: Countertops made and fitted by one East Moline shop
paragraphs: M & L Countertops & More is the shop to call for countertops in East Moline when you want laminate or solid surface done start to finish. The same team measures your kitchen, fabricates the tops, delivers them and installs them.

That means one crew is responsible for the fit. Customers mention that M & L will cut to fit, and that the price was great, which matters when you are replacing tops on a kitchen you already like. Laminate gives you looks like white marble or dark slate on a budget. Solid surface, including brands such as Corian, gives you a solid, non-porous top in speckled or plain colours.

about.text: M & L Countertops and More Inc is a countertop shop at 3919 17th St in East Moline, Illinois. Its own description on Facebook is short and practical: it provides measuring, fabrication, delivery and installation of laminate and various brands of solid surface countertops. That focus shows in its project photos, from a white marble-look laminate kitchen with a new double sink to a dark slate-look peninsula and speckled solid surface tops on cream cabinets. More than 500 people follow the shop on Facebook, and the office keeps early weekday hours for homeowners and contractors.

service_area.h2: Countertops in East Moline and nearby
service_area.text: M & L Countertops & More works from its shop at 3919 17th St in East Moline, Illinois, measuring and installing countertops in homes in and around East Moline. If you are not sure whether your home is in range for measuring and installation, call (309) 792-1886 Monday to Thursday between 7 AM and 3:30 PM, or email the shop with your address.

items.q: What countertop materials do you work with?
items.a: M & L works with laminate and various brands of solid surface, including Corian. Laminate comes in many patterns, such as white marble-look and dark slate-look finishes. Solid surface comes in speckled and solid colours and is fabricated in the shop to fit your cabinets.

items.q: Do you install, or only sell countertops?
items.a: Both. M & L provides measuring, fabrication, delivery and installation, so one company handles the job from the first measurement to the finished top in your kitchen. That includes cutting the openings for your sink and fitting the backsplash on site.

The shop is open Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday from 7 AM to 3:30 PM. It is closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday. You can email MLCOUNTertops96@gmail.com at any time and follow up by phone at (309) 792-1886 during opening hours.

M & L Countertops & More is at 3919 17th St, East Moline, IL 61244. Call ahead at (309) 792-1886 before you visit so the right person is there to talk through materials, colours and measurements for your new kitchen countertops.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Call (309) 792-1886 or email the shop with your rough measurements and the material you are thinking about. A final price depends on measuring your actual cabinets. Customers have written that M & L took care of their needs at a great price.
